title: Liquid Exchange Contracts Value Anthropic at $1.7 Trillion in Pre-IPO Slide
summary:
The speculative market price for shares in AI developer Anthropic has fallen further on cryptocurrency platforms following the disclosure of the firm's official listing documents. Trading contracts for the startup's equity on the Liquid exchange now imply a total market valuation of $1.7 trillion.

This figure marks a continued decline from a peak of about $1.9 trillion recorded earlier this week and represents a drop of nearly 20% over the last month. These pre-IPO perpetual futures allow speculators to trade the perceived value of a company's stock before it formally begins trading on a public exchange, and prices have slid since the company's S-1 filing became public on Monday.
